title: The Book of Curiosities
author: John Platts

authorInfo.bio: John Platts (1775–1837) was an English Unitarian minister and author, a compiler of reference works.

description: "The Book of Curiosities" by John Platts is a collection of wonders and remarkable accounts covering various aspects of nature, art, and humanity, written in the mid-19th century. This volume aims to explore astonishing phenomena, customs, and achievements across the globe, offering readers a glimpse into the extraordinary diversity and complexity of the world around them.
